text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I spot Grass Wonder and
Hishi
Amazon standing by the front gate.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello there, Trainer. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hishiama and I are about to go buy some
things
for the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry you always get stuck carryin' bags.
Nobody
else ever steps up.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, this is no trouble at all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, please! I'll take all the help I can
get!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Very well, then. We won't turn down
your
generosity.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, how about we split up? You
and Grass
can work together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We need to stock the kitchen and get
some house
supplies. Which do you
wanna take care of?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right... the list for house
supplies is
a bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Grocer
text_block_list.text:
Our prices can't be beat! We just started
a
limited-time sale, so don't miss out!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear that? The grocer is having
a flash
sale.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Which would you like to do, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what a coincidence. I was thinking
the same
thing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
'Kay, I'll hit up the general store, then.
This
scene's all you!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There's already a crowd forming at the
entrance...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Please don't worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I might not enjoy crowded or noisy
places, but
that itself is the battle.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Nothing ventured, nothing gained, as
they say.
Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No time for second thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder swiftly weaves through
the swarm
of gathering shoppers.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. I'm waiting in this line.

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text: Hey! You're in my way!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
May I ask that you mind your manners
and wait in
line like the rest of us?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She skillfully manages to keep the pushy
shopper
from shoehorning her way into
the middle of the
line.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Do you mind if I grab a few of these
carrots?

text_block_list.name: Lady B
text_block_list.text: G-go right ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She confirms with the people around her
before
reaching in to grab a few
discounted carrots.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Phew... Here are all my spoils.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder downright conquers the
flash sale
without a single blemish on her
display of
decorum.
choice_data_list: That was pretty incredible on so many levels...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Don't be silly. You haven't seen anything
yet.

text_block_list.name: Clerk A
text_block_list.text:
That's right, folks! You won't find 'em
cheaper
elsewhere!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh? That store over there is having a
flash sale
too...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Heheh, shall we be on our way? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We pass several more stores holding
limited time
sales and end up with a
troubling number of bags.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I got a little carried away...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! It's all good! Our dormies eat
like there's
no tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hishiama... Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's competitive spirit comes
out in
full force, even on shopping trips.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There are more supplies on the list than
groceries,
so it'd make sense for the two
of us to tackle it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
'Kay! I'll handle the food shoppin', and
you can
take care of the other stuff!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Could I ask you to carry the bags?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We'll be able to take back more than
usual thanks
to your help.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A refill of hand soap, check. Next are
refills of
detergent and air freshener...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Saving when you can is important. And
so is the
treat that comes later...
Hehe. ♪
choice_data_list: They're all refill packs, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We check everything off the list, meet
back up
with Hishi Amazon, and give her
the change.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three... Whoa, thrifty, aren't
ya!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nice goin', Grass! You're so responsible,
I can
always count on ya.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, no. My trainer deserves a lot of the
credit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I gotcha! Well, as thanks for helpin',
lemme treat
ya to somethin' with the
change!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're too generous. How about
some snacks
to go with tea?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking it'd be nice to have a
little tea
ceremony together. If you
wouldn't mind, that is.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's an awesome idea!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so the three of us enjoy a relaxing
teatime
together.
